title: Oil Prices Fall as Trump's Iran Nuclear Talk Comments Ease Supply Concerns
detail: Oil prices declined after President Trump commented on ongoing Iran nuclear negotiations, reducing fears of a prolonged supply disruption through the Strait of Hormuz. The diplomatic signals provided temporary relief to commodity markets that have been under pressure due to sustained shipping interdiction operations in the Persian Gulf.

title: China to Resume Fuel Exports in October After Brief Halt, Trade Sources Say
detail: China is set to resume fuel exports in October following a brief halt, according to four trade sources cited by Reuters. The resumption could ease regional supply pressures compounded by ongoing disruptions to commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.
